content: Firestore mobile SDKs (iOS/Android) enable offline persistence by default (unlike web). Snapshot listeners left disconnected >30 minutes are billed as a brand-new query (full read cost) on reconnect rather than an incremental diff -- relevant to session/practice apps that may sit idle. Keep result sets narrow with where/orderBy/limit, attach listeners only when the UI needs live data, and detach when not needed to avoid stacking listeners across screens.
